upstream.unmodified_check: all 92 gepa/ files in venv match gepa-0.1.4.dist-info/RECORD sha256 (0 modified), checked 2026-10-21
upstream.entry_point: gepa.optimize(...) called as-is; custom GEPAAdapter + reflection_prompt_template dict + stop_callbacks + callbacks are all upstream extension points

port_files.gepa_full_port.py: GEPAAdapter (evaluate = common rollout k=3; reflective dataset), component <-> candidate-dir mapping, reflection prompts, stoppers, callbacks, run_summary.json
port_files.lsf_gepa_full_search.sh: LSF launcher: node_env, gateways (Gemma :4113, GLM :4115), warm-up, test-id guard, refuse-overwrite, helper-gate spec, run_meta.txt, isolation scan
port_files.isolation_scan.py: post-search scan of the reflection prompts/replies for gold paths, secrets names and test ids (counts only)

common_layer_used.helper_gate_spec: surface+helpers blocks of arms/capevolve/template/.capevolve/project/capevolve.yaml, copied per run into runs/gepa_full/<NAME>/helpers_spec.yaml and exported as CAPEVOLVE_HELPERS_SPEC

seed: seed_capability_v2, byte-identical: the port asserts the materialized seed dir's file sha256s equal exp895/BUILD_RECORD.json seed_v2.files_sha256 before starting

selection_data.optimizer_sees: official train 80 (split_ids.json 'train'): reflection minibatches of 3 tasks; per task the lowest-scoring of 3 trials' transcript, per-trial scores and the scorer's gold-safe feedback
selection_data.selects_on: official val 40 (split_ids.json 'val'): GEPA valset, Pareto front per val task; champion = highest val mean (GEPA best_idx)
selection_data.never: the 280 test ids: the launcher refuses a run whose train/val holds one, and the port asserts the same before any rollout

venv_installs_for_this_arm: none (gepa 0.1.4, litellm 1.82.6, pyyaml 6.0.3 were already in exp895/venv)
run_env_differences_vs_capevolve_launche: GW_GLM_TIMEOUT=900 for the GLM gateway (GEPA's reflection calls are non-streamed, up to 16k output tokens); see deviations D7
no sandbox shim / unix-socket bridge: GEPA's optimizer is a tool-less LM call, it cannot read files
